categories_thin: Financial and wealth advisers - searched again this round with a map query centred on Sayreville plus web searches. Every hit was outside the township (1200 Tices Ln and 77 Milltown Rd in Milltown/East Brunswick, Cranbury Rd and Brunswick Woods Dr in East Brunswick, Matawan Rd in Old Bridge); the only in-town listings were a bank branch and a credit union, which the brief excludes. Sayreville advisers appear to be home-based or meet clients elsewhere.

Property management - re-mapped this round. The in-town hits were apartment complexes (The Place at Sayreville, Camelot at Townelake, Winding Wood Apartments, Gillette Towers) and a notary listed under management; the actual management companies were in East Brunswick, Milltown, Old Bridge and Metuchen. Only one small Sayreville firm and one service-only listing remain.

Staffing and employment agencies - re-mapped. Of the map hits, three plausible Sayreville/Parlin candidates checked out as elsewhere: Industrial Staffing Services is at 25 Kennedy Blvd, East Brunswick; Empire Workforce Solutions' NJ branch is Elizabeth; and Nursing Care Connect's 476 Main St listing could not be corroborated by any other record. Volt, Aerotek and Staffmark-type branches are national chains and excluded. The two Parlin agencies added are directory-only.
Real estate appraisal - searched again; the appraisers who came up serve Sayreville from Edison and elsewhere in Middlesex County, so no Sayreville-based appraisal office could be listed.

Land surveying and environmental consulting - surveying is no longer empty (Volosin Associates added); environmental consulting is still covered only by Carlin-Simpson's geotechnical/environmental practice, with the other environmental firms found in East Brunswick, Old Bridge and Matawan.

Independent real estate brokerages - the in-town branded offices (RE/MAX First Realty, RE/MAX Dreams, Century 21 and Weichert branches, State Farm and Allstate agent offices) are franchises the brief excludes, which leaves few independent brokerages.
caveats: Parlin is an unincorporated section of Sayreville Township, so Parlin addresses (ZIP 08859) are recorded with town 'Parlin'. Washington Rd addresses in the 368-515 block split across the two ZIPs: 368 Washington Rd reads Sayreville 08872 and 515 Washington Rd reads Parlin 08859.

Seven entries were removed in this revision as out of zone or unverifiable, and one duplicate pair was merged: removed were All One Insurance Agency LLC (100 Plainfield Ave, Edison), Loeb And Haas LLC (2071 NJ-35, South Amboy), AVC Tax & Accounting Services and Alto CPA Group (Klimek Pl addresses that read South Amboy 08879, with map pins east of Parlin), Pinnacle Accounting & Tax Services (8 Old Bridge Tpke, South River per its own contact page), GotWorX Staffing (corporate office in Freehold) and Robert Downey General (an unresolvable insurance pin; the verifiable business of that name is a general contractor at 302 Jernee Mill Rd, which is group C and outside this brief's scope). Cafaro Stanley CPA and CAFCO Financial Services LLC were merged into one entry.

Two entries a verifier could not corroborate - CNJ Insurance Agency and Central Jersey Graphics - were re-checked on their live map listings during this revision and both still appear with full address, phone and hours. They are kept but marked as map-listing-only, so triage should confirm before any outreach.

Branded franchise agencies were excluded per the brief: State Farm agent offices (John Pepe Jr., Juan Nava), Allstate agencies (Thomas Schreiner), Edward Jones and Ameriprise adviser offices, H&R Block / Liberty Tax / Jackson Hewitt tax offices, RE/MAX / Century 21 / Weichert branches, and national staffing chains (Volt, Aerotek, Staffmark).

Websites are recorded only where a listing linked one or the site was opened. Most map pins expose a 'Website' button whose URL is not visible in the result list, so the triage team should follow those up.

Several entries are bulk-directory only (Pay Smart, Volk Insurance, Salaam Insurance, Kiro Group, All Temp Logistics, Louis Search Group, Flex Resources, Xtreme Business Consulting, Track Point Consulting) and are marked as such in active_evidence.
Entries carried over unchanged from the earlier round keep the source URLs recorded then; entries corrected or added in this revision cite pages opened or returned during this revision.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Superpages, ChamberofCommerce.com and seniorfinanceadvisor.com returned HTTP 403 to both the fetch tool and the browser, so those bulk directories could only be read through search-result summaries.

Google Maps in an unsigned-in browser returns roughly 10-13 pins per keyword query; about ten keyword variants were run this round and unioned, so storefront practices are well covered but small home-based offices may still be missed.

The Borough of Sayreville site was checked this round and its contacts page lists municipal departments and staff only - no licensed-business or economic-development directory - so no municipal list could be mined.

Candidates that could not be confirmed in zone and were therefore not listed: Nursing Care Connect (476 Main St, no corroborating record), Empire Workforce Solutions and Industrial Staffing Services (East Brunswick/Elizabeth offices), Raritan Agency and Theodore Sliwinski (East Brunswick), Sai CPA Services and Versutus Accounting (Auer Ct, East Brunswick), PNF Accountants & Advisors (NJ-18, East Brunswick), Meky Accounting Firm (50 Main St, South River).

CME Associates could not be pinned down to a single current address: its association profile and the contact page put it in Parlin, but the practice has since been assigned to/re-branded as Artheon with an East Brunswick (Tower Center Blvd) address, and the map pin follows East Brunswick. Township should be confirmed from a tax record before outreach.

A few entries have no street address (Courtney Lowry Architect, CNJ Property Services, Douglas R. D'Antonio, William A. Aitken, Flying Irishman Consulting, Cutting Edge Consulting) or only a slogan name (WE WANT TO BUY YOUR HOUSE).
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable from this environment in the earlier round and was not retried here, so no OSM cross-check exists.
No site required a login, so nothing was skipped for authentication; all blocks were bot protection.
